pick.headline: Swedish Prime Minister Olof Palme assassinated
pick.summary: Late on 28 February 1986 Swedish Prime Minister Olof Palme was shot dead on a Stockholm street while walking home from a cinema.
pick.significance: Palme was a prominent figure in East-West and North-South diplomacy. The killing went unsolved, fuelling theories that included foreign intelligence services.
